# Emulation plan (10 pattern(s), foundations and constituents first)

### Step 1: Passwordless auth (`passwordless-auth`)
Included because mcp-authorization builds on it.
Risk: medium — external managed service (email delivery)
Needs: required email-delivery, relational-db
Not shown: 0 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 2 code entry point(s), 2 doc(s).

### Step 2: Rate limiting (`rate-limiting`)
Included because hosted-mcp builds on it; mcp-authorization builds on it.
Risk: medium — throttling correctness affects both abuse defense and legitimate-user access
Needs: required key-value-store
Not shown: 0 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 2 code entry point(s), 1 doc(s).

### Step 3: Hosted MCP (`hosted-mcp`)
Included because mcp-authorization builds on it.
Risk: low — structural pattern, no external services
Needs: required key-value-store (via rate-limiting) · v10r's implementation uses relational-db
Not shown: 0 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 2 code entry point(s), 1 doc(s).

### Step 4: MCP authorization (`mcp-authorization`)
Satisfies: mcp authorization
Risk: high — an authorization server; verified in-process against the real library, not yet against any real MCP host or a deployment
Needs: required email-delivery (via passwordless-auth), key-value-store (via rate-limiting), relational-db
Avoid when: The surface is read-only and reveals nothing per user — keep it public and rate-limited
Not shown: 6 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 8 code entry point(s), 1 doc(s).

### Step 5: AI tool manifest and harness split (`ai-tool-harness`)
Included because ai-surfaces builds on it; deskbot-approval-gate builds on it; mcp-client builds on it; untrusted-content-boundary builds on it.
Risk: high — governs what an LLM is allowed to execute
Needs: required llm-provider
Avoid when: The model gets no tools — a plain completion has no execution, risk tier or compaction for a harness to govern
Not shown: 3 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 5 code entry point(s), 2 doc(s).

### Step 6: AI surfaces (`ai-surfaces`)
Included because deskbot-approval-gate builds on it.
Risk: high — user-facing LLM behavior and permissions
Needs: required llm-provider · conditional relational-db (when conversations are kept beyond the page)
Avoid when: The product needs only a read-only answer-bot — ship that one surface and add the acting agent later, together with its approval gate
Not shown: 3 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 8 code entry point(s), 4 doc(s).

### Step 7: Durable step execution (`durable-step-execution`)
Included because it is part of deskbot-approval-gate.
Risk: medium — leases without fences and app-clock leases are the classic failures; both are checked here
Needs: required relational-db
Avoid when: The work is one statement — a single transaction is already all-or-nothing
Not shown: 6 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 4 code entry point(s), 1 doc(s).

### Step 8: Deskbot approval gate (`deskbot-approval-gate`)
Included because mcp-client builds on it; untrusted-content-boundary builds on it.
Risk: high — the safety boundary for AI mutation
Needs: required llm-provider, relational-db
Avoid when: Every tool is read-only or a reversible create — requiresApproval gates write and destructive risk only, so nothing would become a proposal
Not shown: 7 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 7 code entry point(s), 3 doc(s).

### Step 9: Untrusted-content boundary (`untrusted-content-boundary`)
Included because mcp-client builds on it.
Risk: medium — the wrapper lowers but cannot remove the chance a model follows embedded text; the guarantee comes from leg 2 and leg 3 staying closed, which the gate holds
Needs: required llm-provider, relational-db (via deskbot-approval-gate, durable-step-execution)
Avoid when: The assistant only ever reads a corpus you own and has no tools that act or send — there is no untrusted leg to bound
Not shown: 4 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 4 code entry point(s), 1 doc(s).

### Step 10: MCP client (`mcp-client`)
Satisfies: mcp authorization
Risk: high if wired without review — contained by default-write risk, fingerprint pins and the egress guard
Needs: required external-api, llm-provider, relational-db
Avoid when: The tools are yours — add them to the catalogue instead
Not shown: 5 invariant(s) that MUST hold, 4 code entry point(s), 2 doc(s).
